Base_tags.inputs: @createArray(concat('appCatID:', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId']), concat('createdBy:', outputs('Requester')), concat('createdById:', body('HTTP_Get_requester')?['id']), concat('createdTimestamp:', outputs('Now')), concat('lastUpdatedBy:', outputs('Requester')), concat('lastUpdatedTimestamp:', outputs('Now')), concat('managedBy:', body('Get_settings')?['ManagedByTag']), concat('requestId:', triggerOutputs()?['body/Title']))

Group_meta.inputs: @concat(' [appCatID=', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId'], '; requestId=', triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], '; createdBy=', outputs('Requester'), '; managedBy=', body('Get_settings')?['ManagedByTag'], ']')

equals: @and(or(contains(body('Target_team_tags'), concat('team:user\', toLower(body('HTTP_Get_requester')?['id']))), equals(variables('varGroupOwner'), 'yes')), or(empty(body('Filter_appcat_tag')), empty(triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId']), equals(first(body('Filter_appcat_tag')), concat('appCatID:', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId']))))

inputs.name: varFailMessage
inputs.value: Not an authorized owner: the app's team tag names neither you (team:user\<your id>) nor a group you are a member of (team:group\<group id>), or its appCatID differs. Nothing was changed.

Updated_tags.inputs: @union(body('Filter_kept_tags'), createArray(concat('lastUpdatedBy:', outputs('Requester')), concat('lastUpdatedTimestamp:', outputs('Now')), concat('requestId:', triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'])), if(empty(body('Filter_appcat_tag')), createArray(concat('managedBy:', body('Get_settings')?['ManagedByTag'])), json('[]')), if(and(empty(body('Filter_appcat_tag')), not(empty(triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId']))), createArray(concat('appCatID:', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId'])), json('[]')))

inputs.name: varFailMessage
inputs.value: You are not a member of the owning group. Nothing was created.

App_tags.inputs: @union(outputs('Base_tags'), createArray(variables('varTeamTag'), concat('teamName:', variables('varTeamGroupName'))), if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['appEnv']), json('[]'), createArray(concat('appEnv:', outputs('Payload')?['appEnv']))), if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['borShortName']), json('[]'), createArray(concat('borShortName:', outputs('Payload')?['borShortName']))), body('Select_optional_tags'))

parameters.request/body:
{
  "displayName": "@{outputs('Payload')?['displayName']}",
  "description": @{if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['description'], ''))), 'null', concat('"', take(trim(outputs('Payload')?['description']), 1024), '"'))},
  "signInAudience": "@{outputs('Payload')?['signInAudience']}",
  "notes": "@{concat('appCatID=', triggerOutputs()?['body/AppCatId'], '; requestId=', triggerOutputs()?['body/Title'], '; createdBy=', outputs('Requester'), '; managedBy=', body('Get_settings')?['ManagedByTag'])}",
  "tags": @{outputs('App_tags')},
  "appRoles": @{body('Select_app_roles')},
  "api": { "requestedAccessTokenVersion": 2 },
  "web": { "redirectUris": @{if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisWeb']), json('[]'), split(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisWeb'], ';'))} },
  "spa": { "redirectUris": @{if(empty(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisSpa']), json('[]'), split(outputs('Payload')?['redirectUrisSpa'], ';'))} },
  "groupMembershipClaims": "@{outputs('Payload')?['groupMembershipClaims']}",
  "optionalClaims": {
    "idToken": @{body('Select_id_token_claims')},
    "accessToken": @{body('Select_access_token_claims')},
    "saml2Token": []
  }
}

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: app registration ', body('HTTP_Create_application')?['displayName'], ' created (client ID ', body('HTTP_Create_application')?['appId'], ', object ID ', body('HTTP_Create_application')?['id'], '), owner tag ', variables('varTeamTag'), if(greater(length(body('Select_app_roles')), 0), concat(', ', string(length(body('Select_app_roles'))), ' app role(s)'), ''))

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Failed: Application ID URI and scopes were not set (', coalesce(body('HTTP_Expose_API')?['error']?['message'], 'no answer after 6 attempts'), '). Use Expose an API on this app to add them.')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: Application ID URI ', replace(outputs('Payload')?['exposeApi']?['identifierUriTemplate'], '{appId}', body('HTTP_Create_application')?['appId']), ' and ', string(length(body('Select_scopes'))), ' scope(s) set')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: enterprise application created (object ID ', variables('varSpId'), '), assignment required: ', if(equals(outputs('Payload')?['appRoleAssignmentRequired'], false), 'no', 'yes'))

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Failed: enterprise application not created (', coalesce(body('HTTP_Create_SP')?['error']?['message'], concat('HTTP ', string(outputs('HTTP_Create_SP')?['statusCode']))), '). Use Enterprise application on this app to create it.')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: Application ID URI ', variables('varResult')?['identifierUri'], ' and ', string(length(body('Select_new_scopes'))), ' new scope(s) added')

inputs.name: varFailMessage
inputs.value: This app already has an enterprise application. Nothing was changed.

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: enterprise application created (object ID ', variables('varSpId'), '), assignment required: ', if(equals(outputs('Payload')?['appRoleAssignmentRequired'], false), 'no', 'yes'))

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Skipped: ', string(length(variables('varAssignTodo'))), ' role assignment(s), because there is no enterprise application to assign them on')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Failed: ', items('Apply_to_each_assignment')?['displayName'], ' -> role ', items('Apply_to_each_assignment')?['roleValue'], ' (the group has no Object ID: add it with Add existing group and pick it again)')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Failed: default access for ', variables('varTeamGroupName'), ' (', coalesce(body('HTTP_Assign_default_access')?['error']?['message'], 'no answer after 6 attempts'), '). Use Role assignments, or assign it in Entra (Enterprise applications > the app > Users and groups).')

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @concat('Done: default access to the enterprise application for ', variables('varTeamGroupName'))

inputs.name: varLog
inputs.value: @'Note: assignment is required and no group holds any of the app roles yet, so nobody can sign in. Give a group a role with Role assignments.'
